description: This is a Java interface named EcuDefinition that declares methods related to an ECU (Engine Control Unit) definition, such as retrieving ECU ID, calibration ID, car string, inheritance info, and the ECU definition file.

classes.name: EcuDefinition
classes.description: An interface defining methods for accessing ECU definition attributes.

methods.name: getCarString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the car.

methods.name: getInherits
methods.description: Returns inheritance information for the ECU definition.

methods.name: getEcuDefFile
methods.description: Returns the ECU definition file object.
